identity.availability: I’m completing an MEng in Software Engineering at Concordia University and seeking full-time AI/ML roles after graduating in December 2026.

highlights: Shipped a bilingual English/French RAG agent for the internal sales network, used by 700+ employees and cutting manual document search time by 60%.

Fine-tuned a DistilBERT query router from Datadog logs, served it with FastAPI, and managed its MLOps lifecycle in ClearML.
Deployed Open WebUI with LiteLLM, Redis, and Azure Container Apps for 50+ concurrent users with zero downtime over four months.
Built an LLM-as-judge evaluation harness, prototyped AWS Strands agents, and created 10+ reusable Claude skills adopted team-wide.
Led vulnerability management for 40,000+ servers and mitigated 10,000+ exploitable vulnerabilities.
Ran quarterly assessments across 100,000+ devices at 99%+ compliance.
Authored 30+ CIS-based security policies and reduced zero-day threat exposure by 70% using virtual patching.
Built a five-service e-commerce platform in Java, Spring Boot, and Spring MVC.
Containerized services with Docker and automated CI/CD through Jenkins and Maven.
Connected REST services with Spring Cloud, MySQL, MongoDB, and Spring Security.
